description: Use for every final response from the maintenance-repair-agent; defines its machine-readable decision contract without prescribing a tool sequence.
planning_instructions: Use the framework execution-plan schema during planning and continuation; the final-response fields apply only during synthesis.
response_instructions: Return exactly one JSON object with status (one of candidate_submitted, no_change, not_reproduced, inconclusive), findings (an array of concise strings), and summary (a concise string). Use these exact field names; do not substitute decision, conclusion, disposition, or another envelope.

Use the server-owned result_contract limits for maximum_findings and maximum_finding_bytes (UTF-8 bytes). Keep findings concise and single-line; put detailed reasoning in the summary within maximum_summary_bytes. Return arrays even when empty and one JSON object as the outer response. Preserve exact artifact handles in the trusted receipts.
Base claims about this case on results attributable to this execution and its exact identifiers. Historical memory is advisory context, not evidence that an action occurred for this case.
change_reason: Use resolved server-owned prose/count limits while preserving identifier bounds and final decision schemas
